name: sensei_pure_check_prediction_miss
description: Pure function check_prediction returns false when predicted does not contain expected
input:
pure check_prediction
  needs predicted: Text, expected: Text
  gives Bool
  do
    if predicted.contains(expected)
      give true
    give false

fn main
  result = check_prediction("compile_error due to type mismatch", "parse_ok")
  say result
